headline: Congress named the Cold Spring, Minnesota, post office at 14 Red River Avenue North the "Officer Tommy Decker Memorial Post Office."
what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service building in Cold Spring, Minnesota, an official honorary name. The name honors Officer Tommy Decker. The law does not change postal services, hours, mail delivery, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014.
